corrections.reason: The right leg of 'ባ' is shortened (4th order ራብዕ), forming the Amharic relative temporal clause 'ባየ ጊዜ' ('when he saw' translating Ge'ez 'ወርእዮ'), whereas 'በየ' ('every') is a misread of the leg length.
The cross-reference numeral is ፰ (8), referring to Luke 8:2 (ሉቃ ፰ ፪) where Mary Magdalene is introduced; the bottom loop of ፰ was slightly faded and misread as ፮.
The printed glyph has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) right-side stroke 'ሙ' ('ወእሙ ለዮሳ' - 'and the mother of Joses' with proleptic pronominal suffix before 'ለዮሳ').
